artifacts.title: P5 sequencing and evidence boundary
artifacts.body: The September 28 owner waiver activates Phase 2 while Phase 1 remains Not Qualified. Preserve restoration, Test Explorer and customization gaps. P5 must qualify useful Project Mind through direct GUI work without a model; P6 audits the evidence and does not authorize Phase 3. This record separates sequencing permission from qualification truth. Independent backend peer save confirms revisions coordinate separate processes.

artifacts.title: Stopped-writer recovery checklist
artifacts.body: Stop every Dope writer before backing up the entire .dope directory. Preserve corrupt bytes and the legacy Note; inspect revision and UUIDs before restoring a known-good snapshot. A crashed writer lock needs explicit confirmation that its owner is gone, then removal of only that lock. Peer reminder: after a rename uncertainty, reread the committed revision before retrying. Draft reconciliation note: keep both the peer update and the local recovery reminder. Stale-save reminder: independent backend instances also compare expected revision. Project-switch reminder: a protected draft stays attached to Dope until resolved.

artifacts.title: Measure snapshot size before changing storage
artifacts.body: Readable full-snapshot persistence is enough for Phase 2. Park benchmarking ideas until measured project knowledge size makes linear validation/search/replacement costly; do not add a database or index now. Upgrade only after profiling representative collections.

artifacts.title: Keep restoration diagnosis separate from Phase 3
artifacts.body: Retain the Phase 1 restoration failure as evidence. Investigate ordinary editor layout reconstruction before planning a later product phase; capturing this Idea must not create a task or expand scope.

artifacts.title: Does the sequencing waiver qualify Phase 2?
artifacts.body: Clarify whether proceeding despite Phase 1 Not Qualified reduces the Phase 2 GUI/package gates. The activation source is docs/planning/p2/activation.md.
artifacts.answer: No. The waiver permits sequencing only. P5 direct GUI gates and P6 evidence audit remain mandatory; Phase 3 is unapproved.

artifacts.title: What remains unproved after P4?
artifacts.body: P4 instrumented restart tests cannot prove direct keyboard editing, draft navigation, peer conflicts or usable browser restoration. Keep the interactive result and exact package boundary in the P5 evidence.

artifacts.title: Qualify P5 using browser and retain P4 package evidence
artifacts.decision: Use the approved browser-hosted Theia surface for direct P5 interaction.
artifacts.context: P4 separately proves the 0.2.4 AppImage native launch and contents; native app control is unavailable in this session.
artifacts.rationale: The approved P5 surface allows direct clicks and typing without replacing package proof.
artifacts.consequences: Browser observations do not establish native visual usability. Keep any observed browser crash as a separate unresolved observation.
artifacts.alternatives: Native GUI interaction would be another approved surface when available.
artifacts.revisitConditions: Revisit if product source changes or browser behavior blocks the required matrix.

artifacts.title: Require all direct GUI gates before P6 handoff
artifacts.decision: The browser surface is valid, but no P5 success marker is allowed until every required GUI step is Green.
artifacts.context: The browser connection was interrupted and recovered in a new tab. The owner identified the interruption as a connection issue; no product-code cause is established. P4 automated passes cannot replace the required direct GUI matrix.
artifacts.rationale: A usable application restart and recovery are part of the product promise, not a source-only claim.
artifacts.consequences: Partial evidence keeps P6 blocked unless the owner separately waives audit sequencing.
artifacts.alternatives: Treating build success as qualification would leave real workflow defects unexamined.
artifacts.revisitConditions: Revisit after complete GUI replay and exact final validation.

artifacts.title: Use P4 automated passes as P5 proof
artifacts.decision: Skip direct GUI qualification because process tests passed.
artifacts.context: Rejected qualification shortcut captured for durable rationale.
artifacts.rationale: This conflicts with the approved interactive gate; reject the proposal.
artifacts.consequences: Would hide unusable restoration and draft behavior.
artifacts.alternatives: Exercise all direct steps and preserve failures.
artifacts.revisitConditions: No supported condition for skipping the gate without an explicit owner waiver.

artifacts.title: Use supported Theia dialog for Planning block reasons
artifacts.decision: Replace the Planning Step block reason browser prompt with the existing supported Theia text input dialog.
artifacts.context: Phase 3 direct browser dogfooding must block a Step with a visible reason, and the in-app browser does not support window.prompt.
artifacts.rationale: The shared Planning transition must work through the real Theia GUI without browser-native prompt support.
artifacts.consequences: Blocking remains explicit and reasoned; cancelling the dialog performs no canonical mutation.
artifacts.alternatives: Keep window.prompt and record P5 Not Green.
artifacts.revisitConditions: Revisit only if Theia provides a more specific validated multiline dialog.
